newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken up on rumours, upgrade report.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken up on rumours, upgrade report.

text.p: Shares in Swedish banking group Nordbanken surged on Thursday, bucking negative trends on the Stockholm Stock Exchange.
At 1430 GMT, the share was up 12.5 crowns at 219 crowns, while the general index was down 0.46 percent at 2360.13. But turnover was low in both Nordbanken shares and on the bourse overall.
The share was boosted by continous merger speculation and by a Thursday newspaper report that Goldman Sachs has placed Nordbanken on its 'priority list,' dealers said.
Furthermore, the share was also recovering after being sluggish before Christmas.
"It is the old talk about a takeover and that the share has been pretty tired earlier," a trader said. "In addition, Goldman Sachs has increased its recommendation on Nordbanken."
Speculation has targeted a merger between Nordbanken and S-E-Banken, but the latter was down one crown at 69 crowns.
